description:
MiniMax H3 Max Turbo.

Mode is determined by the inputs:
- Text-to-video: prompt only
- Image-to-video: prompt + image and/or end_image

prompt.description: Video prompt. Use timeline markers like [0s-3s] for scene pacing.
examples: A cinematic tracking shot through a misty forest at dawn, golden light filtering through ancient trees.
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: First frame image. The output canvas follows this image.
image.title: Image

end_image.description: Last frame image. Can be given alone for end-only generation; the canvas then follows this image.
end_image.title: End Image

target_audio.description: Audio clip (2s or longer, max 15 MB) pinned as the soundtrack. Trimmed to the video length. Use duration of at least 2s.
target_audio.title: Target Audio

duration.description: Video duration in seconds (1-15). Output can run up to ~0.7s longer.
duration.title: Duration

resolution.description: 480P fastest, 768P native quality, 1080P latent refinement from 768P.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for text-to-video. Ignored when an image is given (the canvas follows the image).

prompt_expansion_mode.description: Prompt rewriting effort: disabled (none), balanced (~1s), or quality (~30s extra).

title: AppInput
